title: Ex 1.1 #7 · {x ∈ ℝ : x² + 5x = −6}
prompt: Write the set $\{x \in \mathbb{R} : x^2 + 5x = -6\}$ by listing its elements between braces.
answer_format: A set listed between braces, like {1, 2, 3} (∅ for the empty set). Steps are optional.
hints: Move everything to one side and factor the quadratic.
x² + 5x + 6 factors into two linear factors.
solution: Rewrite the equation as x² + 5x + 6 = 0, which factors as (x + 2)(x + 3) = 0, so x = −2 or x = −3.
